errors.text_span: Линията, представляваща „Печалба“ (син цвят), започва при стойност около 150 000, намалява леко до около 120 000 в средата на оста X и след това се възстановява до около 160 000 в края.
errors.evidence: The description provides multiple incorrect values for the 'Печалба' (Profit) line. The line starts at approximately 160,000 (not 150,000), dips to approximately 140,000 (not 120,000), and recovers to a value higher than its start, approximately 175,000 (not 160,000). The description's values are consistently underestimated and misrepresent the overall trend.
The starting value for the 'Оборот' (Turnover) line is stated as approximately 450,000, but the chart shows it starting significantly higher, at approximately 470,000-480,000.
The 'Стойност на активите' (Value of assets) line ends at a value almost exactly on the 700,000 mark, not at 690,000. While a small difference, the point aligns clearly with the 700,000 grid line.

The description claims the x-axis has 'evenly spaced ticks' ('равномерно разположени отметки'). The x-axis in the figure has no tick marks; it is an unlabeled categorical axis with three data points plotted along it.
